text:
emily: DeployBot kicked off release v2.4.1 into the scheduled change window (US-evening). We're using a staged 'thermostat' ramp for the feature flag `new-llm-route` — +10% every 5m with holdpoints at 30%, 60%, and 100%. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 2.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 1200ms. Pin canary to model=v2.4.1 until steady. Release notes: https://go/redwood/release/v2.4.1

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started -> canary-group-3 (service=llm-router, task=lr-canary-3). Planned ramps queued.

corey: ACK. Can someone paste the runbook + dashboards?

emily: Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/llm-deploys. Dashboards: https://go/redwood/dashboards/llm-routing (watch error_rate, p50/p95, token cost).

raj: Oncall here — I'll watch errors and logs. If we hit hallucination or quality regression we'll roll back and pin to v2.4.0.

alina: Quick clarification: thermostat checks include CPU headroom + queue depth before permitting the next step, right?

emily: Yes — thermostat gating = cpu < 70%, avg queue < 25ms, no error spike. If any gating metric trips we hold and notify.

sarah: :thumbsup: creating short-lived alert (20m) for error_rate and p95. Also tracking token-cost delta.

deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: cpu=45%, p95=420ms, error_rate=0.12%, token_cost_delta=+3% — proceeding to holdpoint. Next ramp in ~5m.

raj: If we need to pin quickly, what's the exact pin procedure? corey, confirm command?

corey: Pin via runbook: ```./ops/pin_version.sh --service llm-router --version v2.4.0 --reason "rollback perf/regression"``` Or use Console -> Routes -> Pin version (GUI). Also we can `ff toggle new-llm-route off` to fast-disable.

emily: Note: automatic fallback is configured to route to fallback-model=v2.3.x if the routing plugin detects a 5xx spike. That's a safety net.

sarah: Observability note: token-level cost currently +3.2% vs baseline — within expected. I'll raise if >6%.

deploy-bot: Ramp executed: reached 30% (3/10 cohorts). Metrics stable for 2m.

alina: Infra ✅. Holding at 30% for health window (10m).

emily: If we see hallucination regressions, immediate plan: 1) `ff toggle new-llm-route off` 2) pin to v2.4.0 3) notify product + users.

raj: I'll signal rollback if error_rate > 1.5% AND user-reported quality issues > 5 in 15m.

corey: Added a short note to post-deploy: CPU/p95/errors at each holdpoint + any pin actions.

emily: Good. I'll post final post-deploy summary in #release-notes when we finish the 100% ramp. Thanks folks.

deploy-bot: Next ramp scheduled in ~8m. Will post updates at each holdpoint.

sarah: Watching dashboards. Ping me @sarah if anything noisy.

emily: Closing thread for now — will reopen if we need to act.
